description: This file defines the Office365VideoService class, which manages OAuth authentication and credential handling for Office 365 video integration within a conferencing module.

classes.name: Office365VideoService
classes.description: Service class for handling OAuth flow, credential management, and API interactions with Office 365 Video platform.

methods.name: getOffice365AppKeys
methods.description: Retrieves Office 365 app credentials from the repository, throws if not found.

methods.name: generateOffice365AuthUrl
methods.description: Generates the OAuth authorization URL for Office 365 login.

methods.name: connectOffice365App
methods.description: Handles OAuth callback, exchanges code for tokens, fetches user info, manages credentials, and returns redirect URL.
